section.sectionSummaryBrief: This section explains that the primary service in exile is through yichuda tata'ah (lower unity), but it requires the power and remembrance of yichuda ila'ah (higher unity), which is connected to the study of the inner dimensions of Torah.
section.t: b)
And the explanation is,
as explained at length in Kuntres Etz HaChayim137,
at length,
that the service stemming from yichuda tata'ah is in the aspect of "After Hashem your G-d you shall go,"
and the service stemming from yichuda ila'ah is in the aspect of self-nullification (bittul bimetziut)
(meaning that the aspects of yichuda ila'ah and yichuda tata'ah are aspects of "face" and "back" in service).
And now138
the Torah speaks mostly,
and particularly in the time of exile,
the primary service is in the aspect of yichuda tata'ah
("After Hashem your G-d you shall go"),
but even then there must be a remembrance of the service in the aspect of yichuda ila'ah
[a remembrance analogous to the remembrance of Amalek.
For Amalek is the letters of "Melek" (wringing the neck),
from the term "and he shall wring its head from opposite its nape"81,
meaning that the place of its nourishment is in the aspect of "back" and its function is to cause forgetfulness
(as above, that the matter of forgetfulness stems from the aspect of "back").
Therefore the verse specifically warns regarding it: "Remember, do not forget"139].
That from time to time, at least, his service must be in the aspect of yichuda ila'ah,
in order for his service in the aspect of yichuda tata'ah to have endurance, there must be a giving of power and illumination upon it from the service in the aspect of yichuda ila'ah.
And the aspect of yichuda ila'ah illuminates within the aspect of yichuda tata'ah.
And the aspect of yichuda ila'ah
(which gives power for the endurance of the service in the aspect of yichuda tata'ah)
is connected with the study of the inner dimensions of Torah (pnimiyut haTorah),
as explained there140
that the matter of pnimiyut haTorah is as it is written141
"Know the G-d of your father,"
meaning to know His greatness etc., and through this is accomplished
(as the conclusion of the verse)
"and serve Him with a whole heart,"
that the service is in completeness
(this is as above, that the aspect of "face" of Torah
(pnimiyut haTorah)
is connected with the aspect of "face" in service,
the service in the aspect of yichuda ila'ah).

section.sectionSummaryBrief: This section explains that the ultimate purpose is for the essential Shechinah to be in the lower worlds, achieved through our service in exile which draws down the revelation of the inner aspect of Atik Yomin in the future.
section.t: c)
And in general,
this is
(that the aspect of "face" will be drawn down also into the aspect of "back")
that the ultimate intention is that the essential Shechinah be in the lower worlds.
And as explained in Pri Etz Chayim142
that all our deeds and service during the time of exile reach only the aspect of the externality of Atik Yomin,
and in the future there will be a revelation of the aspect of the inner dimension of Atik Yomin.
Nevertheless, our deeds and service during the time of exile draw down the reward of the days of Mashiach and what follows143,
the general concept of which is as it is written144
"Your Teacher will no longer be concealed,"
and "the glory of Hashem will be revealed and all flesh together will see"145
until it will be in the aspect of "face to face,"
that the aspect of the inner dimension of Atik Yomin will be revealed.
And what they accomplish now is through the fact that in the time of exile there is the empowering force of the inner dimension of Torah
(which stems from the aspect of the inner dimension of Atik Yomin),
for "those who taste it merit life"146 etc.
And pnimiyut haTorah brings one to service in the aspect of self-nullification (bittul bimetziut),
which brings one to service whose general concept is yichuda ila'ah,
and this service is connected with the inner dimension of the soul,
as explained in many places,
and this is a close preparation that something analogous to this will be drawn down
(to this service),
in the measure of the Holy One, blessed be He, which is measure for measure129,
meaning that specifically through "your springs will burst forth outward"
(the aspect of pnimiyut haTorah stemming from the aspect of the inner dimension of Atik Yomin etc., which brings about service stemming from the inner dimension of the soul etc.)
"will come the Master, King Mashiach" etc.
(the revelation of the aspect of the inner dimension of Atik Yomin,
the essential Shechinah,
in the lower worlds).

section.sectionSummaryBrief: This section explains that the entire point of the maamar of the Baal HaHilula is the drawing of the aspect of "face" into "back," like the yud in the dalet, to establish the essential Shechinah in the lower worlds through our service, culminating in the revelation of Mashiach.
section.t: d)
And this is
(the drawing of the aspect of "face" into "back,"
like the yud in the dalet)
also the general point of the maamar of the Baal HaHilula,
whose beginning is "I have come to My garden, My orchard,"
to the place which was My primary dwelling initially, that the essential Shechinah was in the lower worlds,
and it is understood that what is said
(in the Midrash)
"essential Shechinah,"
the intention is the inner dimension of the Shechinah150,
which is connected to the inner dimension of what is above, up to the aspect of the inner dimension of Atik Yomin.
And this aspect must be specifically in the lower worlds,
and this is accomplished through the service of man,
until through the service they effect, as the conclusion of the maamar continues151 etc.
that they "set up the legions of Hashem,"
and "open the hidden treasures,"
and "all the precious wealth in the treasures which his fathers and the king himself gathered, they distribute to the men of the army through the officers of the legion and the heads of the army,"
which refers,
in general,
to "your heads for your tribes,"
the heads and princes of Israel in every generation,
for "the extension of Moshe is in every generation"152
until the prince of our generation, the Baal HaHilula,
and "they will awaken and sing, dwellers of the dust"153
and he is among them, and he will lead us upright to our land very soon,
to greet the face of our righteous Mashiach who will teach Torah to the entire nation154,
the inner dimension of Torah,
and speedily in our days.
